cr_data.provenance:
April 21, 1955, sold by Downtown Gallery, New York (stock no. 216) to the William H. Lane Foundation, Leominster, MA [see note 1]; 1990, gift of the William H. Lane Foundation to the MFA. (Accession Date: September 18, 1990) 
 
NOTES: 
[1] Archives of American Art, Downtown Gallery Records, Series 4, Business Records: Sales Slips (1 of 2), 1955: Reel 5628 (Box 72), Frame 170. 
(Source: MFA Boston, 2025)
remarks_1999: Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold Downtown Gallery 1955." Stretcher inscriptions indicate preparation of support. Titled *Patio with Black Door* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Patio with Black Door

credit_line: Gift of the William H. Lane Foundation
description: An adobe wall, seen from a sharp angle, extends across the canvas. A square black door interrupts the smooth, light brown surface of the wall. A sliver of brown ground with pale steppingstones is visible below, while a small triangle of white sky appears overhead.
title: Patio with Black Door
